title: Starting today, we're offering free Kimi API credits to support scientific research worldwide. Selected teams will receive free Kimi API credits, access to our latest models, and opportunities for long-term collaboration. The program builds on our commitment to op
title_en:
Starting today, we're offering free Kimi API credits to support scientific research worldwide.

Selected teams will receive free Kimi API credits, access to our latest models, and opportunities for long-term collaboration.  

The program builds on our commitment to open-weight models by making frontier AI more accessible to researchers.  

AI has the potential to change what can be studied, who can study it, and at what scale, making it possible to pursue a wider range of scientific questions with limited resources.  

Both theoretical and experimental research in fundamental science and engineering are welcome. We hope to help researchers take on more challenging and original questions, including those that have historically received less attention or funding.  

Apply by Dec 8 for the first round: https://www.kimi.ai/news/kimi-for-science-program

该计划建立在我们对开放权重模型的承诺之上，让研究人员更容易接触到前沿人

欢迎基础科学和工程领域的理论和实验研究。我们希望帮助研究人员解决更具挑战性和原创性的问题，包括那些历来受到较少关注或资助的问题。

title: New Microsoft paper finds that AI coding tools write bigger bug fixes than human programmers (2.33X bigger than human developers) mainly because they add tests and documentation, while their actual code is about as necessary as a human's. Agent patche
title_en:
New Microsoft paper finds that AI coding tools write bigger bug fixes than human programmers (2.33X bigger than human developers) mainly because they add tests and documentation, while their actual code is about as necessary as a human's.

Agent patches change 2.33 times as many lines as developer fixes, which is widely read as over-editing. Size alone cannot say whether the extra edits are needed, what they are, or where they come from.

They replayed 7,660 GitHub Copilot CLI runs from 18 models and traced each patch block to the step that wrote it. They then removed each block, reran the tests, and graded developer patches the same way.

On SWE-bench Verified, 61% of the extra edits were tests, and agent patches averaged 88.7% needed code blocks versus 86.4% for developers. The unneeded code came from writing the fix, not debug leftovers, and 3 Gemini Flash models left more than developers.

Report needed-code share next to resolve rate when comparing coding agents, and cut over-editing through training and post-run pruning.
title_zh:
微软的新论文发现，人工智能编码工具比人类程序员编写了更多的错误修复（比人类开发人员大 2.33 倍），主要是因为它们添加了测试和文档，而它们的实际代码与人类的代码差不多。

代理补丁更改的行数是开发人员修复的行数的 2.33 倍，这被广泛解
author: @rohanpaul_ai
summary_zh:
读为过度编辑。仅凭大小并不能说明是否需要额外的编辑、它们是什么或它们来自哪里。

他们重放了 18 个模型的 7,660 次 GitHub Copilot CLI 运行，并跟踪每个补丁块到编写它的步骤。然后，他们删除了每个块，重新运行测试，并以相同的方式对开发人员补丁进行分级。

在 SWE-bench Verified 上，61% 的额外编辑是测试，代理补丁平均需要 88.7% 的代码块，而开发人员则为 86.4%。不需要的代码来自于编写修复程序，而不是调试剩余的代码，3 个 Gemini Flash 模型留下的代码比开发人员还多。

在比较编码代理时，报告所需的代码共享，以解决率，并通过培训和运行后修剪来减少过度编辑。

On SWE-bench Verified, 61% of the extra edits were tests, and agent patches averaged 88.7% needed code blocks versus 86.4% for developers. The unneeded code came from writing the fix, not debug leftovers, and 3 Gemini Flash models left more than developers.

title: we got GTA 6 multiplayer on PC before GTA 6 Online
title_en: we got GTA 6 multiplayer on PC before GTA 6 Online
title_zh: GTA 6多人模式预计将于2027年推出
author: @tomwarren
summary_en: Rockstar Games has released Grand Theft Auto 6 with a primary focus on the single-player experience, without officially confirming the multiplayer roadmap. According to insights from Twitch CEO Dan Clancy regarding their collaboration, the multiplayer expansion is currently targeted for a 2027 release.
summary_zh: Rockstar Games尚未确认GTA 6多人模式具体上线时间，但根据Twitch内部信息，该功能计划于2027年上线。
full_text_zh: 我们在 GTA 6 Online 之前就在 PC 上推出了 GTA 6 多人游戏
full_text_en: we got GTA 6 multiplayer on PC before GTA 6 Online

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Rockstar Games在发布Grand Theft Auto 6时初期仅提供单机模式，目前尚未正式官宣多人在线功能的具体落地窗口。据Twitch首席执行官Dan Clancy透露，双方正就平台集成进行深度协作，预计多人模式的上线时间点定于2027年。

elements_en.who: Rockstar Games, Twitch CEO Dan Clancy
elements_en.where: Game launch and streaming platform integration
elements_en.what: Multiplayer mode for GTA 6 is projected for 2027
elements_en.why: To maximize player retention and leverage long-term monetization

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Rockstar Games采用“单机造势、联机长线变现”的策略，将多人模式延迟至游戏发布多年后上线，旨在最大化单一IP的生命周期价值。这种分阶段发布模型可有效对冲开发压力，并为平台生态的高频交互预留充分的测试与适配缓冲期。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Rockstar Games employs a 'single-player market penetration, multiplayer long-term monetization' strategy, delaying the multiplayer mode to maximize the IP's lifecycle. title: It's an exciting time to be a software engineer. Yes, the role is changing. But there remain so many interesting & ambitious problems yet to be solved. "This is for the engineers feeling an identity crisis because they think their knowledge and skills won't be impor
title_en:
It's an exciting time to be a software engineer. Yes, the role is changing. But there remain so many interesting & ambitious problems yet to be solved.

"This is for the engineers feeling an identity crisis because they think their knowledge and skills won't be important - you and your skills can be the difference in whether or not these problems get tackled and multiagent systems can solve the world’s hardest problems. You can and should go deep in these domains, learn new things, and form opinions. So much of this problem space is wide open for new solutions."
title_zh:

author: @addyosmani
summary_zh: 智能体系统是否可以解决世界上最困难的问题。你可以而且应该深入这些领域，学习新事物，并形成意见。这个问题的大部分空间都为新的解决方案敞开了大门。”
full_text_en:
It's an exciting time to be a software engineer. Yes, the role is changing. But there remain so many interesting & ambitious problems yet to be solved.

"This is for the engineers feeling an identity crisis because they think their knowledge and skills won't be important - you and your skills can be the difference in whether or not these problems get tackled and multiagent systems can solve the world’s hardest problems. You can and should go deep in these domains, learn new things, and form opinions. So much of this problem space is wide open for new solutions."
full_text_zh:
对于一名软件工程师来说，这是一个激动人心的时刻。是的，角色正在改变。但仍有许多有趣且雄心勃勃的问题有待解决。

“这是对于那些感到身份危机的工程师来说，因为他们认为自己的知识和技能并不重要——你和你的技能可能会决定这些问题能否得到解决，而多智能体系统是否可以解决世界上最困难的问题。你可以而且应该深入这些领域，学习新事物，并形成意见。这个问题的大部分空间都为新的解决方案敞开了大门。”

title: ▲ Sakana AI just introduced Sakana Namazu Small, a 30B reasoning model that tops NVIDIA's 120B Nemotron 3 Super on its own 25-benchmark average. The key idea is heavy post-training on a small open base. Sakana took the pretrained Nemotron 3 Nan
title_en:
▲ Sakana AI just introduced Sakana Namazu Small, a 30B reasoning model that tops NVIDIA's 120B Nemotron 3 Super on its own 25-benchmark average.

The key idea is heavy post-training on a small open base. Sakana took the pretrained Nemotron 3 Nano base (30B total, 3B active) and ran its own continued pretraining and post-training. The target is web-search research and answering from long documents with evidence.

The numbers (self-reported): 60.1 average vs 56.2 for Nemotron 3 Super and 50.2 for Nemotron 3 Nano. BrowseComp jumps to 73.5 vs 36.1 for Super. It is a trade-off though: closed-book recall lags, with SimpleQA Verified at 6.8 vs 18.1 for Super.

No weights, license or pricing yet. Sakana plans on-premises availability and will share details in early-to-mid December 2026......

Full analysis: https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/26/sakana-ai-namazu-small-30b-nemotron-3-nano/

Announcement: http://sakana.ai/namazu-small

Base model: http://huggingface.co/blog/nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-efficient-open-intelligent-models

Paper (Nemotron 3 Nano): http://arxiv.org/abs/2512.20848

@SakanaAILabs
title_zh:
▲ Sakana AI 刚刚推出了 Sakana Namazu Small，这是一款 30B 推理模型，其 25 基准平均值超过了 NVIDIA 的 120B Nemotron 3 Super。

关键的想法是在小型开放基地进行大量的后期训
author: @Marktechpost
summary_zh:
练。 Sakana 采用预训练的 Nemotron 3 Nano 基础（总共 30B，活跃 3B）并运行自己的持续预训练和后训练。目标是网络搜索研究并从带有证据的长文档中进行回答。

数字（自我报告）：平均 60.1，Nemotron 3 Super 为 56.2，Nemotron 3 Nano 为 50.2。 BrowseComp 跃升至 73.5，而 Super 则为 36.1。但这是一个权衡：闭卷回忆滞后，SimpleQA Verified 为 6.8，而 Super 为 18.1。

尚无重量、许可证或定价。 Sakana 计划在本地提供服务，并将于 2026 年 12 月上旬至中旬分享详细信息……

title: how does AI generated text impact evaluation on our pre-training index? if you remove ai generated text from uncheatable eval, inkling 2 small goes from 4th place to 8th place 👀 for deepseek v4 it's the exact opposite, which is coherent since deepseek tech re
title_en:
how does AI generated text impact evaluation on our pre-training index?

if you remove ai generated text from uncheatable eval, inkling 2 small goes from 4th place to 8th place 👀

for deepseek v4 it's the exact opposite, which is coherent since deepseek tech report explicitly says they don't use synthetic data during pre-training

on average post-trained models lean toward AI text (+2%) and base models away (-3%)

this analysis is based on @jennajrussell and @dlwh work on @MarinCommunity! i made small changes like i finetuning qwen3 0.6B on Pangram 4 labels, since open pangram was quite bad at it (56% accuracy on held-out docs vs 88% for the finetuned qwen). both are on the site, you can switch between them!
title_zh:
人工智能生成的文本如何影响我们预训练指数的评估？

如果你从不可取消的评估中删除人工智能生成的文本，Inkling 2 Small 就会从第四名上升到第八名👀

对于 deepseek v4 来说，情况恰恰相反，这是一致的，因为 deeps
author: @eliebakouch
summary_zh:

title_en:
Seedance 2.5 vs Wan 3.0 with the same prompt

I made both videos on @makeugc. After my Kling 4.0 comparison, I wanted to see how Wan 3.0 would handle the same jump rope vlog.

1. As I mentioned in my last post, I got the Seedance clip on the first try. I gave Wan three tries and picked the second take because the woman looked the most realistic in that one.

2. The Seedance clip looks more realistic to me overall. Wan’s version is brighter, the colors are richer, and I really like the lighting in the gym. The woman looks believable too, though I think Wan went a little overboard with the sweat.

3. Wan costs a lot less per generation. That matters when you want to try the same prompt a few times.

4. I’ve had good results with Wan in other tests too. Personally, I still prefer Seedance for video quality.

5. Both models followed the prompt well overall. The biggest difference for me was the missed jump. In the Wan clip, she stops jumping before the rope even touches her foot, so the stumble feels staged. I think she starts saying her line a little early too.

I’d still pick Seedance for a tricky scene like this, but I’m happy with how Wan did. Which version did you prefer?

PROMPT ⬇️

**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. A self-filmed gym vlog: MILA holds the camera for the opening selfie, then props it securely on a low bench for the jump-rope shots. Slight hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed autofocus and a briefly cropped forehead in the selfie. Once propped, the camera stays still; tighter inserts are simple crops of that same recording. Casual hard cuts omit setup time. The camcorder never appears on screen or in the mirror.

**LOOK:**
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under gym lighting, subtle auto-exposure fluctuations, muted contrast, realistic skin tones. MILA looks like a real woman recorded in an ordinary gym: natural skin texture, small imperfections, fine loose hairs and spontaneous facial expressions remain visible beneath the gentle tape softness. Soft overhead lighting creates believable shadows beneath her chin and feet. No beauty-filter smoothing or glossy commercial grading.

**STYLE:**
Playful, self-deprecating gym-vlog tone — initial confidence, a few genuinely good jumps, one tiny mistake and an extremely well-earned water break. Real effort mixed with humor. Short, casual cuts, normal-speed movement and a light, funny finish.

**Character**

MILA — a beautiful American Instagram-style brunette model and performer, 20. Long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin with a light sweat sheen, glossy lips, expressive eyes, soft glam makeup and delicate sparkly stud earrings. Slim athletic figure with a very large, full bust, very full rounded buttocks, a narrow waist, flat stomach and lean arms and legs.

She wears a cobalt-blue supportive sports bra with thin straps and a deep scoop neckline showing cleavage, paired with matching ultra-short fitted athletic shorts. Bare shoulders, arms and midriff. White ankle socks, sneakers off. She speaks with an American accent.

Her ponytail follows each jump with a slight natural delay. Her shoulders stay relaxed, knees soften on landing, and her fitted sportswear moves naturally with her body.

**Setting**

A gym mat area in the evening, with a flat rubber exercise floor, a mirror wall off to one side and other equipment visible in the background. Soft overhead lighting. One clear, half-full water bottle with a white flip-top drinking spout stands beside the bench, well outside the rope's path. One ordinary dark jump rope with two black handles. Enough clear space above and around her for the full rope arc.

**Storyboard (15s, 6 shots)**

1. *(0–2s, handheld arm's-length selfie)*  
MILA looks into the lens with an overly confident little smile, holding both rope handles together in her free hand. One loose strand of hair rests against her cheek. The framing dips slightly as she starts lowering the camera toward the bench.  
MILA: “This looks easy.”

2. *(2–5s, propped camera, full-body shot)*  
Hard cut: the camera is now resting on the bench, and MILA is already jumping a few steps away. Her whole body, both handles and the rope's overhead arc fit in frame. She makes several small, steady two-foot hops, turning the rope with compact wrist movements, elbows close to her sides. The bottle remains visible beside the bench at the edge of frame. Her ponytail bobs behind her.  
No dialogue — rhythmic rope taps, soft landings and light breathing.

3. *(5–7s, tighter insert from the same propped recording)*  
A simple crop onto her lower legs, white socks and the floor. The rope skims the rubber just ahead of her toes, passes beneath both feet during each small hop, then continues behind her. Her ankles and knees absorb each landing. A little natural motion blur follows the moving rope.  
No dialogue. Keep the same jumping rhythm across the cut.

4. *(7–9s, back to the full-body framing)*  
The rope catches lightly against her toes on the next pass. Its rotation stops; she settles onto both feet and takes one small recovery step, still holding a handle in each hand. She looks down at the slack rope, then back toward the lens with an amused, mildly offended expression.  
MILA, with a breathy little laugh: “Okay. Rude.”

5. *(9–11.5s, propped camera, medium crop near the bench)*  
Jump cut: she is crouched beside the bench. She places both handles and the slack rope on the floor, then picks up the same water bottle with her left hand and flips its drinking spout open with her right. Her shoulders rise and fall with slightly quicker breathing; she smiles to herself.  
No dialogue. A small plastic click and quiet gym ambience.

6. *(11.5–15s, closer crop, camera still propped)*  
Still crouching near the lens, she raises the open bottle, takes one brief, ordinary sip, lowers it and swallows. The water tilts naturally inside the bottle. She lets out a small satisfied breath, looks straight into the camera and gives a cheeky half-smile.  
MILA: “Still counts.”  
Finish on her amused expression, with the bottle lowered in her hand.

**Audio and continuity**

Natural American-accented speech with accurate lip sync. Soft gym room tone, rope swishes and floor taps synchronized with each rotation, light breathing, the bottle's lid click and a quiet sip. Leave space between actions and dialogue. No music, voiceover, captions or added comedy effects.

Keep MILA's face, proportions, outfit, hairstyle, lighting and surroundings consistent. The rope remains one continuous cord attached to the same two handles: one rotation per hop, no extra loops, disappearing sections or passage through her body. Both hands hold their respective handles throughout the jumping. The same bottle stays beside the bench until she visibly picks it up.

1. 正如我在上一篇文章中提到的，我第一次尝试就得到了 Seedance 剪辑。我给了万三次尝试，选择了第二次，因为那个女人看起来最真实。

2.整体而言，Seedance 剪辑对我来说看起来更真实。万的版本更亮，颜色更丰富，我很喜欢健身房的灯光。这个女人看起来也很可信，尽管我认为万的汗水有点过头了。

3. 每一代的WAN成本要低得多。当您想多次尝试相同的提示时，这一点很重要。

4. 我和Wan一起在其他测试中也取得了不错的成绩。就我个人而言，我还是更喜欢 Seedance 的视频质量。

5. 两种型号总体上都很好地遵循了提示。对我来说最大的区别是错过了跳跃。在万的剪辑中，她在绳子接触到她的脚之前就停止了跳跃，所以这次绊倒感觉像是上演的。我认为她也很早就开始说她的台词了。

对于这样棘手的场景，我仍然会选择 Seedance，但我对 Wan 的表现很满意。您更喜欢哪个版本？

提示⬇️

**相机：**
DV 16mm 磁带摄像机的手持感觉。自拍的健身视频博客：MILA 拿着相机拍摄开场自拍照，然后将其牢固地支撑在矮凳上拍摄跳绳镜头。轻微的手抖、取景未对准、自动对焦延迟以及自拍照中额头被短暂修剪。一旦被支撑，相机就会保持静止；更紧密的插入是同一录音的简单裁剪。随意的硬剪省去了准备时间。摄像机永远不会出现在屏幕或镜子中。

* *: * *
柔软的，稍微模糊的磁带质量，微弱的磁带噪音，在健身房灯光下绽放的高光，微妙的自动曝光波动，柔和的对比度，逼真的肤色。MILA看起来就像一个真实的女人，记录在一个普通的健身房：自然的皮肤纹理，小瑕疵，精细松散的头发和自然的面部表情，在柔和的胶带柔软下仍然清晰可见。柔和的顶灯在她的下巴和脚下创造了可信的阴影。没有美丽的过滤器平滑或有光泽的商业分级。

**风格：**
俏皮、自嘲的健身视频博客语气——最初的自信、几次真正出色的跳跃、一个小错误和一次非常值得的破水。真正的努力与幽默相结合。简短、随意的剪辑、正常速度的动作以及轻松、有趣的结尾。

**特点**

MILA——一位美丽的美国 Instagram 风格的黑发模特和表演者，20 岁。深棕色长发扎成高马尾辫，皮肤焕发着淡淡的汗水光泽，嘴唇有光泽，眼睛富有表情，妆容柔和迷人，戴着精致闪亮的耳钉。苗条的运动身材，胸围非常大，丰满，臀部非常丰满，腰部细，腹部平坦，手臂和腿都很瘦。

她穿着钴蓝色支撑性运动胸罩，细肩带和深汤匙领口露出乳沟，搭配配套的超短合身运动短裤。裸露肩膀、手臂和腹部。白色及踝袜，运动鞋脱掉。她说话带有美国口音。

她的马尾辫随着每次跳跃而自然地略有延迟。她的肩膀保持放松，膝盖在落地时变软，合身的运动服随着身体自然移动。

**环境**

晚上的健身垫区，有平坦的橡胶运动地板、一侧的镜墙和背景中可见的其他设备。柔和的头顶照明。长凳旁边放着一个透明的、半满的水瓶，上面有一个白色的翻盖饮水嘴，位于绳索路径之外。一根普通的深色跳绳，有两个黑色手柄。她上方和周围有足够的净空间，可以容纳完整的绳索弧线。

**故事板（15秒，6个镜头）**

1. *（0–2秒，手持一臂远的自拍）*
米拉带着过于自信的微笑看着镜头，空着的那只手握住两个绳柄。一缕松散的头发靠在她的脸颊上。当她开始将相机向长凳降低时，取景略有下降。
米拉：“这看起来很简单。”

2. *（2–5秒，支撑相机，全身拍摄）*
硬剪辑：摄像机现在放在长凳上，MILA 已经跳到了几步之外。她的整个身体、两个把手和绳子的头顶弧线都适合框架。她进行了几次小而稳定的两英尺跳跃，用紧凑的手腕动作转动绳子，肘部靠近身体两侧。瓶子在框架边缘的长凳旁边仍然可见。她的马尾辫在身后摆动。
没有对话——有节奏的敲打绳索、轻柔的着陆和轻微的呼吸。

3. *（5–7 秒，从同一支撑录音中更紧密地插入）*
她的小腿、白袜子和地板上都有一个简单的裁剪。绳子在她脚趾前面掠过橡胶，在每次小跳时从双脚下方穿过，然后继续在她身后。她的脚踝和膝盖吸收了每一次落地。随着绳索的移动，会产生一点自然的运动模糊。
没有对话。在剪切过程中保持相同的跳跃节奏。

4. *（7-9秒，回到全身取景）*
在下一次经过时，绳子轻轻地抓住了她的脚趾。它的旋转停止；她双脚站稳，迈出一小步恢复，双手仍各握着一个把手。她低头看着松弛的绳子，然后又看向镜头，脸上带着一种有趣、略带生气的表情。
米拉带着喘息般的小笑：“好吧。粗鲁。”

5. *（9–11.5 秒，支撑相机，长凳附近的中等裁剪）*
跳切：她蹲在长凳旁边。她将两个把手和松弛的绳子放在地板上，然后用左手拿起同一个水瓶，并用右手打开其饮水嘴。她的肩膀随着呼吸的加快而起伏。她对自己微笑。
没有对话。小小的塑料咔嗒声和安静的健身房氛围。

6. *（11.5–15 秒，近距离裁剪，相机仍然支撑）*
她仍然蹲在镜头附近，举起打开的瓶子，简单地喝了一小口，然后放下并吞下。水在瓶内自然倾斜。她满意地呼出一口气，直视镜头，露出一个厚脸皮的微笑。
米拉：“仍然很重要。”
完成她有趣的表情，把瓶子放在她手里。

**音频和连续性**

自然的美国口音，口型准确。柔和的健身房音调、每次旋转同步的绳索嗖嗖声和地板水龙头、轻微的呼吸、瓶盖的咔哒声和安静的啜饮声。在行动和对话之间留出空间。没有音乐、画外音、字幕或添加的喜剧效果。

保持 MILA 的脸型、比例、服装、发型、灯光和周围环境一致。绳子仍然是一根连续的绳索，连接在相同的两个手柄上：每一跳旋转一圈，没有额外的环，消失的部分或穿过她身体的通道。在整个跳跃过程中双手握住各自的手柄。同一个瓶子一直放在长凳旁边，直到她明显拿起它。

full_text_en:
Seedance 2.5 vs Wan 3.0 with the same prompt

I made both videos on @makeugc. After my Kling 4.0 comparison, I wanted to see how Wan 3.0 would handle the same jump rope vlog.

1. As I mentioned in my last post, I got the Seedance clip on the first try. I gave Wan three tries and picked the second take because the woman looked the most realistic in that one.

2. The Seedance clip looks more realistic to me overall. Wan’s version is brighter, the colors are richer, and I really like the lighting in the gym. The woman looks believable too, though I think Wan went a little overboard with the sweat.

3. Wan costs a lot less per generation. That matters when you want to try the same prompt a few times.

4. I’ve had good results with Wan in other tests too. Personally, I still prefer Seedance for video quality.

5. Both models followed the prompt well overall. The biggest difference for me was the missed jump. In the Wan clip, she stops jumping before the rope even touches her foot, so the stumble feels staged. I think she starts saying her line a little early too.

I’d still pick Seedance for a tricky scene like this, but I’m happy with how Wan did. Which version did you prefer?

PROMPT ⬇️

**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. A self-filmed gym vlog: MILA holds the camera for the opening selfie, then props it securely on a low bench for the jump-rope shots. Slight hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed autofocus and a briefly cropped forehead in the selfie. Once propped, the camera stays still; tighter inserts are simple crops of that same recording. Casual hard cuts omit setup time. The camcorder never appears on screen or in the mirror.

**LOOK:**
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under gym lighting, subtle auto-exposure fluctuations, muted contrast, realistic skin tones. MILA looks like a real woman recorded in an ordinary gym: natural skin texture, small imperfections, fine loose hairs and spontaneous facial expressions remain visible beneath the gentle tape softness. Soft overhead lighting creates believable shadows beneath her chin and feet. No beauty-filter smoothing or glossy commercial grading.

**STYLE:**
Playful, self-deprecating gym-vlog tone — initial confidence, a few genuinely good jumps, one tiny mistake and an extremely well-earned water break. Real effort mixed with humor. Short, casual cuts, normal-speed movement and a light, funny finish.

**Character**

MILA — a beautiful American Instagram-style brunette model and performer, 20. Long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin with a light sweat sheen, glossy lips, expressive eyes, soft glam makeup and delicate sparkly stud earrings. Slim athletic figure with a very large, full bust, very full rounded buttocks, a narrow waist, flat stomach and lean arms and legs.

She wears a cobalt-blue supportive sports bra with thin straps and a deep scoop neckline showing cleavage, paired with matching ultra-short fitted athletic shorts. Bare shoulders, arms and midriff. White ankle socks, sneakers off. She speaks with an American accent.

Her ponytail follows each jump with a slight natural delay. Her shoulders stay relaxed, knees soften on landing, and her fitted sportswear moves naturally with her body.

**Setting**

A gym mat area in the evening, with a flat rubber exercise floor, a mirror wall off to one side and other equipment visible in the background. Soft overhead lighting. One clear, half-full water bottle with a white flip-top drinking spout stands beside the bench, well outside the rope's path. One ordinary dark jump rope with two black handles. Enough clear space above and around her for the full rope arc.

**Storyboard (15s, 6 shots)**

1. *(0–2s, handheld arm's-length selfie)*  
MILA looks into the lens with an overly confident little smile, holding both rope handles together in her free hand. One loose strand of hair rests against her cheek. The framing dips slightly as she starts lowering the camera toward the bench.  
MILA: “This looks easy.”

2. *(2–5s, propped camera, full-body shot)*  
Hard cut: the camera is now resting on the bench, and MILA is already jumping a few steps away. Her whole body, both handles and the rope's overhead arc fit in frame. She makes several small, steady two-foot hops, turning the rope with compact wrist movements, elbows close to her sides. The bottle remains visible beside the bench at the edge of frame. Her ponytail bobs behind her.  
No dialogue — rhythmic rope taps, soft landings and light breathing.

3. *(5–7s, tighter insert from the same propped recording)*  
A simple crop onto her lower legs, white socks and the floor. The rope skims the rubber just ahead of her toes, passes beneath both feet during each small hop, then continues behind her. Her ankles and knees absorb each landing. A little natural motion blur follows the moving rope.  
No dialogue. Keep the same jumping rhythm across the cut.

4. *(7–9s, back to the full-body framing)*  
The rope catches lightly against her toes on the next pass. Its rotation stops; she settles onto both feet and takes one small recovery step, still holding a handle in each hand. She looks down at the slack rope, then back toward the lens with an amused, mildly offended expression.  
MILA, with a breathy little laugh: “Okay. Rude.”

5. *(9–11.5s, propped camera, medium crop near the bench)*  
Jump cut: she is crouched beside the bench. She places both handles and the slack rope on the floor, then picks up the same water bottle with her left hand and flips its drinking spout open with her right. Her shoulders rise and fall with slightly quicker breathing; she smiles to herself.  
No dialogue. A small plastic click and quiet gym ambience.

6. *(11.5–15s, closer crop, camera still propped)*  
Still crouching near the lens, she raises the open bottle, takes one brief, ordinary sip, lowers it and swallows. The water tilts naturally inside the bottle. She lets out a small satisfied breath, looks straight into the camera and gives a cheeky half-smile.  
MILA: “Still counts.”  
Finish on her amused expression, with the bottle lowered in her hand.

**Audio and continuity**

Natural American-accented speech with accurate lip sync. Soft gym room tone, rope swishes and floor taps synchronized with each rotation, light breathing, the bottle's lid click and a quiet sip. Leave space between actions and dialogue. No music, voiceover, captions or added comedy effects.

Keep MILA's face, proportions, outfit, hairstyle, lighting and surroundings consistent. The rope remains one continuous cord attached to the same two handles: one rotation per hop, no extra loops, disappearing sections or passage through her body. Both hands hold their respective handles throughout the jumping. The same bottle stays beside the bench until she visibly picks it up.

title: I proved my own math conjecture using AI, thereby also settling a math problem that had been open for 23 years. In 2022, during my PhD, my co-author Thomas Lehéricy and I came up with a conjecture in probability theory that we couldn’t prove. It turns out th
title_en:
I proved my own math conjecture using AI, thereby also settling a math problem that had been open for 23 years.

In 2022, during my PhD, my co-author Thomas Lehéricy and I came up with a conjecture in probability theory that we couldn’t prove. It turns out that Martin Raič had already proposed a special case of this conjecture in 2003, the year I was born. As recently as this February, mathematicians were still publishing papers on closely related questions.

I finished my PhD without a proof or a counterexample, and I kept wondering whether our conjecture was true. Whenever a new AI model came out, I gave it the problem, hoping it would figure out if we were right.

Our conjecture was about the central limit theorem, a cornerstone of probability theory. If you toss a hundred fair coins independently, you get 50 heads on average. The exact number varies, and a bell curve gives a good estimate of how likely you are to get, say, between 45 and 55 heads. We wanted to know how accurate that approximation is when each outcome can depend on a few of the others. We published our conjecture and some partial results in 2024.

I gave the problem to several AI models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2. Those models made partial progress. GPT-6.2 Astra was the first to find a complete proof.

You can find the paper and the accompanying Lean formalization on GitHub below. I’ve also submitted the paper to arXiv and will share the arXiv link once it’s live, likely early next week.

https://github.com/maximilian-janisch/berry-esseen-dependency-graphs

author: @MaximilianJani

3 年，也就是我出生的那一年就已经提出了这个猜想的特例。就在今年二月，数学家们仍在发表有关密切相关问题的论文。

我在没有证明或反例的情况下完成了博士学位，我一直想知道我们的猜想是否正确。每当一个新的人工智能模型出现时，我都会给它提出问题，希望它能弄清楚我们是否正确。

我们的猜想是关于中心极限定理，它是概率论的基石。如果你独立投掷一百枚公平的硬币，平均会得到 50 次正面朝上。确切的数字各不相同，钟形曲线可以很好地估计您获得正面朝上的可能性，例如，在 45 到 55 之间。我们想知道当每个结果都依赖于其他几个结果时，该近似值有多准确。我们在 2024 年发表了我们的猜想和部分结果。

我把这个问题交给了几个 AI 模型，包括 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Fable 5.2。这些模型取得了部分进展。 GPT-6.2 Astra 是第一个找到完整证明的人。

title: John Borthwick (@Borthwick), founder of Betaworks, named his AI agent after himself eleven years ago. Back then, scripted to dodge the question "are you an AI?" with "are you an investor?"⁣ ⁣ His actual position on whether these models are conscious:⁣ ⁣ "
title_en:
John Borthwick (@Borthwick), founder of Betaworks, named his AI agent after himself eleven years ago. Back then, scripted to dodge the question "are you an AI?" with "are you an investor?"⁣
⁣
His actual position on whether these models are conscious:⁣
⁣
"We are growing, not designing some of this technology. We've discovered something in nature."⁣
⁣
But he also points out we fed these models every hope, dream, and fear humans have ever put into language. So a mirror would look exactly like this too.⁣
⁣
Frankenstein was the doctor's name, not the monster's. Borthwick thinks that detail matters more than people realize.

title: How to let your AI agent shop at Walmart this Black Friday & Cyber Monday: @Muse is the only agent with a direct Walmart integration 1/ Open Muse and ask it to connect Walmart. It drops a Walmart connector right in the chat 2/ Tap Connect and sign in to Wal
title_en:
How to let your AI agent shop at Walmart this Black Friday & Cyber Monday:

@Muse is the only agent with a direct Walmart integration

1/ Open Muse and ask it to connect Walmart. It drops a Walmart connector right in the chat

2/ Tap Connect and sign in to Walmart. Muse never sees your password or card number

3/ On the Review & Authorize screen, pick the card and shipping address it uses, then set "Require approval for each order over" to $0, $50, $100 or a custom amount. Mine is $0, so it asks before every order

4/ Check out right in the chat. Same prices as http://walmart.com, no Walmart+ needed, and normal returns still apply

5/ Change any of it later at http://walmart.com/account/your-agents. Tap Muse to edit the card, address or approval amount, see what it bought, or disconnect it for good

Notice: Walmart did add a "Your Agents" page to your account, but other agents like Grok Bot and Instinct aren’t able to connect today 

Happy shopping!

title: Wow, tencent claims DeepSeek V4.1 Flash decodes 3.14x faster with zero quality loss. Their new open drafter DFly2 sits next to the model and guesses 5 tokens ahead, and the big model just checks them Same weights, same output. it's lossless speculative d
title_en:
Wow, tencent claims DeepSeek V4.1 Flash decodes 3.14x faster with zero quality loss. 

Their new open drafter DFly2 sits next to the model and guesses 5 tokens ahead, and the big model just checks them

Same weights, same output. it's lossless speculative decoding, the drafter doesn't replace anything

Details:
- 3.14x average decode speedup across 7 benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME25, MBPP, HumanEval, LCB, MT-Bench), 2.97x end to end with prefill
- the drafter keeps no KV cache of its own... it reads the cache and sparse attention picks the main model already made, so drafting stays at 4-6% of a decode step at any context length
- at high concurrency they claim 62% and 81% more throughput than DSpark on 64K long-context and agentic sets
- drafters are also out for GLM-5.3-Flash and Hy4 flash (Hy4 hits 4.2x on its best single test)
- Apache 2.0, 14B drafter on HF

The catch is that these are all tencent's numbers, on H20 datacenter GPUs at TP8, one request at a time. vLLM support is still "in progress" and there's no llama.cpp or EXL3 path yet, so no 3090 runs for now

Would be awesome for something like this in Maya, DeepSeek Flash on my 3090s would get A LOT faster.
title_zh:
哇，腾讯声称 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 解码速度提高了 3.14 倍，质量损失为零。

他们的新开放起草者 DFly2 坐在模型旁边并猜测前面的 5 个标记，而大模型只是检查它们

相同的重量，相同的输出。这是无损推测解码，起
author: @loktar00
summary_zh:
草者不会替换任何内容

详情：
- 7 个基准测试（GSM8K、MATH、AIME25、MBPP、HumanEval、LCB、MT-Bench）平均解码速度提高 3.14 倍，预填充时端到端速度提高 2.97 倍
- 起草者不保留自己的 KV 缓存...它读取缓存并稀疏注意力选择已经制作的主模型，因此起草在任何上下文长度下都保持在解码步骤的 4-6%
- 在高并发情况下，他们声称在 64K 长上下文和代理集上的吞吐量比 DSpark 高 62% 和 81%
- 起草者也退出了 GLM-5.3-Flash 和 Hy4 flash（Hy4 在其最佳单次测试中达到了 4.2 倍）
- Apache 2.0，HF 上的 14B 起草者

问题是这些都是腾讯的数据，在 TP8 的 H20 数据中心 GPU 上，一次一个请求。 vLLM 支持仍在“进行中”，并且还没有 llama.cpp 或 EXL3 路径，因此目前没有 3090 运行

在 Maya 中实现这样的功能非常棒，我的 3090 上的 DeepSeek Flash 会快很多。

title: IMO Jelani is correct. Investors (correctly) care about the bottom line and not mathematical theorems. I’d add another reason to release results is that by default transparency is good and “information wants to be free”. Sharing results both teaches us about what
title_en:
IMO Jelani is correct. Investors (correctly) care about the bottom line and not mathematical theorems.

I’d add another reason to release results is that by default transparency is good and “information wants to be free”. Sharing results both teaches us about what is true in mathematics (for example the matrix multiplication exponent) and what are the capabilities of AI systems (which we should care about for many reasons).

The IAS seal is “Truth and Beauty” influenced  by Keats’ words: 

“Beauty is truth, truth beauty,”—that is all Ye know on earth, and all ye need to know.

The idea that mathematicians or scientists would prefer to live in ignorance and not know truths is anathema to this maxim.

title: This question was asked in AI Engineering interviews at Moonshot AI and Character . AI. Question: Explain prefix caching / prompt caching. When should you use it, and what invalidates a cached prefix? Let's answer it step by step. Prefix caching, also called p
title_en:
This question was asked in AI Engineering interviews at Moonshot AI and Character . AI.

Question: Explain prefix caching / prompt caching. When should you use it, and what invalidates a cached prefix?

Let's answer it step by step.

Prefix caching, also called prompt caching, saves the KV Cache of a prompt prefix that repeats across requests. When a new request starts with exactly the same tokens, the model loads the saved KV Cache and runs prefill only on the new part.

First, why it helps. Prefill computes the Key and Value of every prompt token in every layer. For a long prompt, this is heavy work, and it decides the time to first token.

Let's say every request has the same 5,000-token system prompt and document, plus a 50-token user question.

- Without caching: prefill on 5,050 tokens, every time.
- With caching: the first request computes all 5,050 tokens and saves the KV Cache of the 5,000-token prefix (a cache write). Every later request loads it and runs prefill on only the 50 new tokens (a cache read).

The answer quality does not change, because the cached Keys and Values are the same ones the model would compute again.

How it works inside the serving engine:
- vLLM hashes each KV Cache block together with all the tokens before it, and a new request reuses every matching block from the start.
- SGLang keeps the cached prefixes in a radix tree (RadixAttention).

When should we use it?
- Long system prompts that are the same for every user
- Tool definitions and few-shot examples in agents
- Large documents with many questions asked about them
- Multi-turn chat: every new turn repeats the full history as the prefix

The rule: put the stable part first, and the changing part last.

What invalidates a cached prefix?

- Any change in the prefix: the match is at the token level from the very first token. Change the token at position 10, and everything from position 10 onward is a miss, because the Keys and Values after it depend on it.
- Dynamic content early: a timestamp or a user name at the top breaks the cache for every request.
- Reordering: tools or documents in a different order give different tokens.
- A different model or version: the KV Cache belongs to the exact weights.
- Eviction: the cache lives in limited GPU or CPU memory. Unused prefixes get removed by LRU or after a time-to-live.
- Routing: in a cluster, a request sent to a server that does not hold the prefix gets a miss. Cache-aware routing fixes this.

The cache is also position-dependent. The same text at a different position has different Keys after RoPE.

In the interview, the most important line is: prefix caching reuses the KV Cache of an exact token prefix, so we design prompts with the static part first and the dynamic part last, and any change before a token invalidates the cache for everything after it.
title_zh:
这个问题是在 Moonshot AI 和 Character 的人工智能工程采访中被问到的。人工智能。

问题：解释一下前缀缓存/提示缓存。什么时候应该使用它，什么会使缓存的前缀无效？

让我们一步一步来回答吧。

前缀缓存也称为提示缓存，
author: @amitiitbhu
summary_zh:
存跨请求重复的提示前缀的KV Cache。当新请求以完全相同的令牌开始时，模型会加载保存的 KV 缓存并仅在新部分上运行预填充。

首先，为什么它有帮助。 Prefill 计算每一层中每个提示标记的 Key 和 Value。对于长提示来说，这是一项繁重的工作，它决定了第一次标记的时间。

假设每个请求都有相同的 5,000 个令牌的系统提示和文档，以及一个 50 个令牌的用户问题。

- 不使用缓存：每次预填充 5,050 个令牌。
- 使用缓存：第一个请求计算所有 5,050 个令牌，并保存 5,000 个令牌前缀的 KV 缓存（缓存写入）。以后的每个请求都会加载它并仅对 50 个新令牌运行预填充（缓存读取）。

答案质量不会改变，因为缓存的键和值与模型将再次计算的键和值相同。

它在服务引擎内部是如何工作的：
- vLLM 将每个 KV Cache 块及其之前的所有令牌散列在一起，并且新请求从一开始就重用每个匹配的块。
- SGLang 将缓存的前缀保留在基数树中（RadixAttention）。

我们什么时候应该使用它？
- 每个用户都相同的长系统提示
- 代理中的工具定义和少量示例
- 包含许多问题的大型文档
- 多回合聊天：每个新回合都会重复完整的历史记录作为前缀

规则：稳定的部分放在前面，变化的部分放在最后。

什么会使缓存的前缀无效？

- 前缀的任何更改：匹配从第一个令牌开始在令牌级别进行。更改位置 10 处的标记，从位置 10 开始的所有内容都会失败，因为它后面的 Key 和 Value 都依赖于它。
- 早期动态内容：顶部的时间戳或用户名会破坏每个请求的缓存。
- 重新排序：不同顺序的工具或文档给出不同的标记。
- 不同的模型或版本：KV Cache 属于精确权重。
- 驱逐：缓存位于有限的 GPU 或 CPU 内存中。未使用的前缀将通过 LRU 或在生存时间后删除。
- 路由：在集群中，发送到不包含前缀的服务器的请求会失败。缓存感知路由解决了这个问题。

缓存也与位置相关。相同的文本在不同的位置经过RoPE之后有不同的Key。

面试中，最重要的一句话是：前缀缓存重用了精确token前缀的KV缓存，因此我们设计提示时先静态，后动态，token之前的任何更改都会导致其之后的所有内容的缓存失效。

Let's answer it step by step.

Prefix caching, also called prompt caching, saves the KV Cache of a prompt prefix that repeats across requests. When a new request starts with exactly the same tokens, the model loads the saved KV Cache and runs prefill only on the new part.

First, why it helps. Prefill computes the Key and Value of every prompt token in every layer. For a long prompt, this is heavy work, and it decides the time to first token.

Let's say every request has the same 5,000-token system prompt and document, plus a 50-token user question.

- Without caching: prefill on 5,050 tokens, every time.
- With caching: the first request computes all 5,050 tokens and saves the KV Cache of the 5,000-token prefix (a cache write). Every later request loads it and runs prefill on only the 50 new tokens (a cache read).

The answer quality does not change, because the cached Keys and Values are the same ones the model would compute again.

How it works inside the serving engine:
- vLLM hashes each KV Cache block together with all the tokens before it, and a new request reuses every matching block from the start.
- SGLang keeps the cached prefixes in a radix tree (RadixAttention).

When should we use it?
- Long system prompts that are the same for every user
- Tool definitions and few-shot examples in agents
- Large documents with many questions asked about them
- Multi-turn chat: every new turn repeats the full history as the prefix

The rule: put the stable part first, and the changing part last.

What invalidates a cached prefix?

- Any change in the prefix: the match is at the token level from the very first token. Change the token at position 10, and everything from position 10 onward is a miss, because the Keys and Values after it depend on it.
- Dynamic content early: a timestamp or a user name at the top breaks the cache for every request.
- Reordering: tools or documents in a different order give different tokens.
- A different model or version: the KV Cache belongs to the exact weights.
- Eviction: the cache lives in limited GPU or CPU memory. Unused prefixes get removed by LRU or after a time-to-live.
- Routing: in a cluster, a request sent to a server that does not hold the prefix gets a miss. Cache-aware routing fixes this.

The cache is also position-dependent. The same text at a different position has different Keys after RoPE.

In the interview, the most important line is: prefix caching reuses the KV Cache of an exact token prefix, so we design prompts with the static part first and the dynamic part last, and any change before a token invalidates the cache for everything after it.
full_text_zh:
这个问题是在 Moonshot AI 和 Character 的人工智能工程采访中被问到的。人工智能。

问题：解释一下前缀缓存/提示缓存。什么时候应该使用它，什么会使缓存的前缀无效？

让我们一步一步来回答吧。

前缀缓存也称为提示缓存，保存跨请求重复的提示前缀的KV Cache。当新请求以完全相同的令牌开始时，模型会加载保存的 KV 缓存并仅在新部分上运行预填充。

首先，为什么它有帮助。 Prefill 计算每一层中每个提示标记的 Key 和 Value。对于长提示来说，这是一项繁重的工作，它决定了第一次标记的时间。

假设每个请求都有相同的 5,000 个令牌的系统提示和文档，以及一个 50 个令牌的用户问题。

- 不使用缓存：每次预填充 5,050 个令牌。
- 使用缓存：第一个请求计算所有 5,050 个令牌，并保存 5,000 个令牌前缀的 KV 缓存（缓存写入）。以后的每个请求都会加载它并仅对 50 个新令牌运行预填充（缓存读取）。

答案质量不会改变，因为缓存的键和值与模型将再次计算的键和值相同。

它在服务引擎内部是如何工作的：
- vLLM 将每个 KV 缓存块及其之前的所有令牌散列在一起，并且新请求从一开始就重用每个匹配的块。
- SGLang 将缓存的前缀保留在基数树中（RadixAttention）。

我们什么时候应该使用它？
- 每个用户都相同的长系统提示
- 代理中的工具定义和少量示例
- 包含许多问题的大型文档
- 多回合聊天：每个新回合都会重复完整的历史记录作为前缀

规则：稳定的部分放在前面，变化的部分放在最后。

什么会使缓存的前缀无效？

- 前缀的任何更改：匹配从第一个令牌开始在令牌级别进行。更改位置 10 处的标记，从位置 10 开始的所有内容都会失败，因为它后面的 Key 和 Value 都依赖于它。
- 早期动态内容：顶部的时间戳或用户名会破坏每个请求的缓存。
- 重新排序：不同顺序的工具或文档给出不同的标记。
- 不同的模型或版本：KV Cache 属于精确权重。
- 驱逐：缓存位于有限的 GPU 或 CPU 内存中。未使用的前缀将通过 LRU 或在生存时间后删除。
- 路由：在集群中，发送到不包含前缀的服务器的请求会失败。缓存感知路由解决了这个问题。

缓存也与位置相关。相同的文本在不同的位置经过RoPE之后有不同的Key。

面试中，最重要的一句话是：前缀缓存重用了精确token前缀的KV缓存，因此我们设计提示时先静态，后动态，token之前的任何更改都会导致其之后的所有内容的缓存失效。

title: Amazon May Finally Let Meta’s Muse AI Agent Shop on Its Store After Two Months of Blocking Checkout https://t.co/C6YCuozheb #android
title_en: Amazon May Finally Let Meta’s Muse AI Agent Shop on Its Store After Two Months of Blocking Checkout https://t.co/C6YCuozheb #android
title_zh: 亚马逊与Meta就Muse AI购物代理接入谈判
author: @Androidheadline
summary_en: Amazon and Meta are negotiating to restore Meta’s Muse AI agent access to Amazon’s product search and checkout systems, following a platform-wide block in September 2025. The core dispute centers on product discovery logic and advertising placement, testing whether retailers will accommodate AI agents as critical intermediaries in the consumer purchasing journey.
summary_zh: 亚马逊与Meta正就恢复Muse AI代理在亚马逊平台的搜索与购物权限进行深度谈判，旨在平衡流量控制权与商业化收益。
full_text_zh: 在阻止结帐两个月后，亚马逊终于可以让 Meta 的 Muse AI 代理在其商店上购物 #android
full_text_en: Amazon May Finally Let Meta’s Muse AI Agent Shop on Its Store After Two Months of Blocking Checkout https://t.co/C6YCuozheb #android

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 亚马逊正与Meta讨论恢复Muse AI代理在平台内的产品搜索及购物结算权限，此前因用户体验与广告逻辑冲突，该权限于2025年9月被封禁。双方的核心博弈点在于如何处理Muse介入后的产品推荐逻辑及广告展示位分配，这将决定AI购物代理能否成为绕过传统电商前端的新流量入口。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Amazon and Meta are negotiating to restore Meta’s Muse AI agent access to Amazon’s product search and checkout systems, following a platform-wide block in September 2025. The core dispute centers on product discovery logic and advertising placement, testing whether retailers will accommodate AI agents as critical intermediaries in the consumer purchasing journey.

elements_zh.where: 亚马逊电商平台生态
elements_zh.what: 重新评估Muse AI的购物代理权限，协商搜索结果及广告展示合规性
elements_zh.why: AI代理作为新型购物中介正在重塑流量发现机制，迫使电商巨头重新衡量合规与转化率的利益分配

elements_en.what: Renegotiating Muse AI agent access, specifically search and ad integration
elements_en.why: The rise of AI agents as shopping intermediaries challenges traditional retail discovery and monetization models

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 电商平台的封闭流量池逻辑正受到AI Agent主动式推荐的直接冲击，零售巨头被迫在‘引流’与‘被降权为后台供应商’之间进行博弈。此次谈判实质上是关于电商广告收入护城河的防御战，若Meta取得结算与推荐入口，将标志着购物发现权从‘平台中心化’向‘用户AI代理’的历史性转移。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The rise of AI-driven shopping agents forces e-commerce giants to confront the erosion of their traditional walled-garden discovery models. This negotiation represents a defensive stance for Amazon's advertising revenue; conceding search and recommendation control to Meta’s Muse signals a shift in power from platform-centric retail to agent-centric consumer discovery.

title: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of $MSFT AI: “For all those people who keep predicting we're overbuilding chips / we aren't seeing jevon's paradox etc. Things are just getting started.”
title_en: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of $MSFT AI: “For all those people who keep predicting we're overbuilding chips / we aren't seeing jevon's paradox etc. Things are just getting started.”
title_zh: 微软AI首席执行官驳斥芯片产能过剩论
author: @aleabitoreddit
summary_en: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI, publicly addressed market skepticism regarding overbuilding AI compute infrastructure, emphasizing that demand remains in its nascent stages. He countered claims that Jevons Paradox is not applicable to AI compute, affirming that current massive capital expenditures are fundamental to AGI development.
summary_zh: 微软AI业务首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼公开回应行业质疑，坚持看好AI基础设施的大规模资本开支。
full_text_zh: $MSFT AI 首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼 (Mustafa Suleyman)：“对于那些不断预测我们正在过度制造芯片的人/我们没有看到杰文悖论等。事情才刚刚开始。”
full_text_en: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of $MSFT AI: “For all those people who keep predicting we're overbuilding chips / we aren't seeing jevon's paradox etc. Things are just getting started.”

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 微软AI首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman）针对市场关于AI算力基础设施建设过度的质疑发表公开声明，强调算力需求正处于早期增长阶段。他明确反驳了关于“杰文斯悖论”（Jevons Paradox）在AI算力领域失效的推断，重申当前的大规模资本投入仍是支撑AGI演进的必要基础。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI, publicly addressed market skepticism regarding overbuilding AI compute infrastructure, emphasizing that demand remains in its nascent stages. He countered claims that Jevons Paradox is not applicable to AI compute, affirming that current massive capital expenditures are fundamental to AGI development.

elements_zh.who: 穆斯塔法·苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman），微软AI首席执行官
elements_zh.where: 社交媒体公开声明
elements_zh.what: 辩护大规模芯片算力部署的必要性，并否定基础设施建设过剩的行业观点
elements_zh.why: 针对近期华尔街及分析师对AI高额资本开支回报率的担忧

elements_en.who: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI
elements_en.what: Defending massive chip deployment and rejecting the overbuilding narrative
elements_en.why: Addressing recent market concerns regarding ROI on AI capital expenditure

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 微软作为核心资本开支方，其立场反映了头部云厂商通过规模化算力摊薄边际成本的深度战略，旨在通过锁定产能构筑护城河。这种对基础设施建设的激进态度，暗示云巨头已将芯片采购视为对抗地缘制裁与算力通胀的长期资本储备，而非简单的短期商业投入。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Microsoft's stance reflects a strategic commitment to reducing marginal costs through massive compute scale to build a competitive moat. This aggressive infrastructure posture suggests that cloud giants view chip procurement as a long-term capital reserve against geopolitical supply chain risks and compute inflation, rather than mere operational expenditure.

title: Great paper from Microsoft on how much coding agents over-edit. It is widely assumed that coding agents over-edit, because their patches are larger than developer patches. This study tested that claim on 7,660 resolved GitHub Copilot CLI trajectories from 18
title_en:
Great paper from Microsoft on how much coding agents over-edit.

It is widely assumed that coding agents over-edit, because their patches are larger than developer patches.

This study tested that claim on 7,660 resolved GitHub Copilot CLI trajectories from 18 frontier models. Their method, Delta Residue Attribution, reverts each block of the final patch, reruns the task tests, and records whether the block was needed.

On SWE-bench Verified, most of the extra lines are tests (61%) and documentation (13%). Agent code was on average at least as necessary as developer code (0.887 vs 0.864), and 11 of 18 models left less unneeded code than developers.

About 11% of an agent's code units were still unneeded, and 89% of those changed behavior. Code necessity had no relation to resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified and a negative one on DeepSWE (Spearman -0.59).

Pruning with only the tests the agent can see removed most of the unneeded code, and 89% of pruned patches still resolved the task.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34875

Chat with Paper: https://academy.dair.ai/papers/how-much-do-coding-agents-over-edit-and-why-an-empirical-study-of-unneeded-edits-2611.34875
title_zh:
来自 Microsoft 的关于编码代理过度编辑程度的精彩论文。

人们普遍认为编码代理会过度编辑，因为他们的补丁比开发人员补丁大。

这项研究在 18 个前沿模型的 7,660 个已解析的 GitHub Copilot CLI 轨迹上测试
author: @dair_ai
summary_zh:
了这一说法。他们的方法，Delta Residue Attribution，恢复最终补丁的每个块，重新运行任务测试，并记录是否需要该块。

在 SWE-bench Verified 上，大多数额外行是测试 (61%) 和文档 (13%)。平均而言，代理代码至少与开发人员代码一样必要（0.887 vs 0.864），并且 18 个模型中有 11 个模型留下的不需要的代码少于开发人员。

大约 11% 的代理代码单元仍然不需要，其中 89% 的行为发生了变化。代码必要性与 SWE-bench Verified 上的解析率无关，而 DeepSWE 上的解析率为负值 (Spearman -0.59)。

仅使用代理可以看到的测试进行修剪，删除了大部分不需要的代码，并且 89% 的修剪补丁仍然解决了任务。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34875

与论文聊天：https://academy.dair.ai/papers/how-much-do-coding-agents-over-edit-and-why-an-empirical-study-of-unneeded-edits-2611.34875

5. Upload references in a fixed order and give each one clear instructions

title: vLLM’s multimodal inference pipeline can now avoid repeated media preprocessing by separating encoder outputs from the requests sent downstream. Newly appointed vLLM (@vllm_project) committer Tianyu Guo (@guoty9) describes two changes to Encod
title_en:
vLLM’s multimodal inference pipeline can now avoid repeated media preprocessing by separating encoder outputs from the requests sent downstream.

Newly appointed vLLM (@vllm_project) committer Tianyu Guo (@guoty9) describes two changes to Encoder–Prefill–Decode (EPD) disaggregation, which separates media encoding, prompt processing, and token generation:

• Direct transfers: The EC Connector initially passed encoder outputs through a shared filesystem. Support for Mooncake and NIXL now enables point-to-point transfers between encoder and prefill instances.

• Metadata-only requests: Instead of carrying raw media, requests to prefill/decode instances carry essential metadata, such as image grid dimensions (image_grid_thw). The encoder’s embeddings reach prefill separately through the EC Connector, avoiding redundant preprocessing.

Guo reports state-of-the-art performance against other open-source inference engines in the scenarios he tested. That qualification matters: this article provides no benchmark figures or configurations, and he acknowledges remaining issues.

The engineering work also comes with a community challenge. Guo reports more than 8,000 PRs and 3,000 issues in the repository, and wants to help contributors receive faster responses and develop proposals through RFCs.
#vLLM #LLMInference #MultimodalAI
title_zh:
vLLM 的多模态推理管道现在可以通过将编码器输出与下游发送的请求分开来避免重复的媒体预处理。

新任命的 vLLM (@vllm_project) 提交者 Tianyuuo (@guoty9) 描述了对编码器-预填充-解码 (EPD) 分
author: @ZhihuFrontier
summary_zh:
解的两项更改，它将媒体编码、提示处理和令牌生成分开：

• 直接传输：EC 连接器最初通过共享文件系统传递编码器输出。对 Mooncake 和 NIXL 的支持现在可以实现编码器和预填充实例之间的点对点传输。

• 仅元数据请求：预填充/解码实例的请求不携带原始媒体，而是携带基本元数据，例如图像网格尺寸(image_grid_thw)。编码器的嵌入通过EC连接器单独到达预填充，避免了冗余的预处理。

郭报告了在他测试的场景中与其他开源推理引擎相比的最先进的性能。这一资格很重要：本文没有提供基准数据或配置，他承认仍然存在问题。

工程工作还面临着社区挑战。郭在存储库中报告了 8,000 多个 PR 和 3,000 个问题，并希望帮助贡献者获得更快的响应并通过 RFC 制定提案。
#vLLM #LLMInference #MultimodalAI
full_text_en:
vLLM’s multimodal inference pipeline can now avoid repeated media preprocessing by separating encoder outputs from the requests sent downstream.

Newly appointed vLLM (@vllm_project) committer Tianyu Guo (@guoty9) describes two changes to Encoder–Prefill–Decode (EPD) disaggregation, which separates media encoding, prompt processing, and token generation:

• Direct transfers: The EC Connector initially passed encoder outputs through a shared filesystem. Support for Mooncake and NIXL now enables point-to-point transfers between encoder and prefill instances.

• Metadata-only requests: Instead of carrying raw media, requests to prefill/decode instances carry essential metadata, such as image grid dimensions (image_grid_thw). The encoder’s embeddings reach prefill separately through the EC Connector, avoiding redundant preprocessing.

Guo reports state-of-the-art performance against other open-source inference engines in the scenarios he tested. That qualification matters: this article provides no benchmark figures or configurations, and he acknowledges remaining issues.

The engineering work also comes with a community challenge. Guo reports more than 8,000 PRs and 3,000 issues in the repository, and wants to help contributors receive faster responses and develop proposals through RFCs.
#vLLM #LLMInference #MultimodalAI
full_text_zh:
vLLM 的多模态推理管道现在可以通过将编码器输出与下游发送的请求分开来避免重复的媒体预处理。

新任命的 vLLM (@vllm_project) 提交者 Tianyuuo (@guoty9) 描述了对编码器-预填充-解码 (EPD) 分解的两项更改，它将媒体编码、提示处理和令牌生成分开：

• 直接传输：EC 连接器最初通过共享文件系统传递编码器输出。对 Mooncake 和 NIXL 的支持现在可以实现编码器和预填充实例之间的点对点传输。

• 仅元数据请求：预填充/解码实例的请求不携带原始媒体，而是携带基本元数据，例如图像网格尺寸(image_grid_thw)。编码器的嵌入通过EC连接器单独到达预填充，避免了冗余的预处理。

郭报告了在他测试的场景中与其他开源推理引擎相比的最先进的性能。这一资格很重要：本文没有提供基准数据或配置，并且他承认仍然存在问题。

工程工作还面临着社区挑战。郭在存储库中报告了 8,000 多个 PR 和 3,000 个问题，并希望帮助贡献者获得更快的响应并通过 RFC 制定提案。
#vLLM #LLMInference #MultimodalAI

title: Google just showed why cache hits matter! (cache-aware routing clearly explained) Varun Mohan from Google's Antigravity team says they raised the cache hit rate for Neon in Antigravity by another 4.5%. he says that means you can "complete 28% more task
title_en:
Google just showed why cache hits matter!

(cache-aware routing clearly explained)

Varun Mohan from Google's Antigravity team says they raised the cache hit rate for Neon in Antigravity by another 4.5%.

he says that means you can "complete 28% more tasks within quota."

Google didn't say how they did it. but one big lever for cache hits sits on the server side, and few developers ever see it. that lever is the router.

a cache hit means the start of your prompt, called the prefix, is already stored as KV cache. so the model skips the work of computing it again.

the catch is that a large deployment has many workers. a worker is one model server, and each worker keeps its own KV cache.

so the cache only helps if your next request lands on the worker that holds it.

a normal load balancer doesn't know this. round-robin sends each request to the next worker in line.

with N workers, a follow-up request has only about a 1/N chance to reach the right worker. with 8 workers, that's 12.5%.

the rest of the time, the worker computes the whole prefix again.

agents feel this the most. every agent turn re-sends the same long prefix with the system prompt, tools, files and earlier turns.

inference routers fix this with prefix-aware routing. here are the main ways, from simple to precise:

↳ prefix affinity sends requests from the same client to the same worker. one busy client can overload that worker.
↳ consistent hashing hashes a session key or the start of the prompt, so requests that share it land on the same worker.
↳ approximate tracking means the router keeps its own guess of what each worker has cached. that guess can go stale after evictions or restarts.
↳ precise tracking has workers send KV cache events, so the router knows where each cache block lives.

good routers then add load to the score. a cache hit on an overloaded worker can still be slower than a smaller hit on a worker with free memory.

you can see this in open source:

- vLLM Router started as a fork of the SGLang gateway and uses consistent hashing to keep a session on the worker that holds its cache
- SGLang router tracks prefixes with radix trees and switches to the shortest queue when load gets uneven
- NVIDIA Dynamo tracks KV cache events and estimates the prefill and decode cost on each worker
- llm-d uses KV cache events from vLLM, SGLang and TensorRT-LLM to route on Kubernetes

if you self-host on several replicas, track your cache hit rate for each workload.

a cache-blind load balancer can waste the cache hits that your prompt layout earned.

hope you found it helpful.

Cheers! :)
title_zh:
谷歌刚刚展示了为什么缓存命中很重要！

（清楚解释了缓存感知路由）

Google Antigravity 团队的 Varun Mohan 表示，他们将 Antigravity 中 Neon 的缓存命中率又提高了 4.5%。

他说这意味着
author: @akshay_pachaar
summary_zh:
你可以“在配额内多完成 28% 的任务”。

谷歌没有透露他们是如何做到的。但是缓存命中的一个重要杠杆位于服务器端，很少有开发人员看到它。那个杠杆就是路由器。

缓存命中意味着提示符的开头（称为前缀）已经存储为 KV 缓存。因此模型会跳过再次计算的工作。

问题是大型部署需要很多工作人员。一个worker就是一个模型服务器，每个worker都有自己的KV缓存。

因此，只有当您的下一个请求到达保存它的工作程序时，缓存才会有帮助。

普通的负载均衡器不知道这一点。循环将每个请求发送到队列中的下一个工作人员。

对于 N 个工作人员，后续请求只有大约 的机会到达正确的工作人员。如果有 8 名工人，则为 12.5%。

其余时间，工作人员再次计算整个前缀。

代理商感受最深。每个代理轮次都会重新发送相同的长前缀以及系统提示符、工具、文件和之前的轮次。

推理路由器通过前缀感知路由解决了这个问题。以下是主要方法，从简单到精确：

↳ 前缀关联将来自同一客户端的请求发送到同一工作人员。一个繁忙的客户可能会使该工作人员超负荷。
↳ 一致散列对会话密钥或提示符的开头进行散列，因此共享它的请求会落在同一工作人员上。
↳ 近似跟踪意味着路由器保留自己对每个工作进程缓存的内容的猜测。在驱逐或重新启动后，这种猜测可能会变得过时。
↳ 精确跟踪让工作人员发送 KV 缓存事件，因此路由器知道每个缓存块所在的位置。

好的路由器会增加分数的负载。对过载工作线程的缓存命中仍然可能比对具有可用内存的工作线程的较小命中慢。

你可以在开源中看到这一点：

- vLLM 路由器作为 SGLang 网关的分支启动，并使用一致的散列在保存其缓存的工作线程上保持会话
- SGLang 路由器使用基数树跟踪前缀，并在负载不均匀时切换到最短队列
- NVIDIA Dynamo 跟踪 KV 缓存事件并估计每个工作线程的预填充和解码成本
- llm-d 使用来自 vLLM、SGLang 和 TensorRT-LLM 的 KV 缓存事件在 Kubernetes 上进行路由

如果您在多个副本上自行托管，请跟踪每个工作负载的缓存命中率。

缓存盲负载均衡器可能会浪费提示布局获得的缓存命中。

希望您发现它有帮助。

干杯! :)

title: I need to go on a hiring spree over the next few months. We just closed a top 10 company (in the world) as a client at The Narrative Company. Comp is up to $200k + equity. We're growing like crazy. Our biggest bottleneck is hiring top tier talent to serve our cus
title_en:
I need to go on a hiring spree over the next few months.

We just closed a top 10 company (in the world) as a client at The Narrative Company. Comp is up to $200k + equity.

We're growing like crazy. Our biggest bottleneck is hiring top tier talent to serve our customers.

First role: cracked engineer

You'll build the agentic systems that handle community engagement and social listening for the top enterprises in the world. We're closing contracts with them every month.

The work is public facing. Community engagement and social listening are 2 workflows that affect the customer's brand, stock and how their ecosystem sees them. So we need someone with 2+ years in a rigorous startup environment who understands how delicate this is. We're a small team and we're moving fast.

Second role: incredible writer

Writing is at the core of thinking. A $3T company will only hire you if you understand what you're doing better than they do. To do community engagement and social listening better than their teams, you need to think well. And for that, you need to write well. Would love to see examples of your writing here. And please don't use AI to write your email to me. It's obvious, and it tells me you won't be able to write for Fortune 500 companies.

Comp for both is up to $200k + equity (yes, we want you to win with us)

Email me at aadit@thenarrative.company with your best work!

Best of luck. Thanks Twitter fam ❤️ If you refer someone we hire, I'd be happy to pay a $5,000 referral bonus.
title_zh:
我需要在接下来的几个月里继续大肆招聘。

我们刚刚作为 The Narrative Company 的客户关闭了一家（全球）排名前 10 的公司。奖金高达 20 万美元+股权。

我们疯狂地成长。我们最大的瓶颈是聘请顶尖人才来服务我们的客户
author: @aaditsh
summary_zh:
第一个角色：破解工程师

您将为世界顶级企业构建处理社区参与和社交聆听的代理系统。我们每个月都会与他们签订合同。

该作品面向公众。社区参与和社交聆听是影响客户品牌、库存以及生态系统如何看待它们的两个工作流程。因此，我们需要一个在严格的创业环境中有两年以上经验的人，他了解这是多么微妙的事情。我们是一个小团队，但我们进展很快。

第二个角色：不可思议的作家

写作是思维的核心。只有当你比他们更了解自己在做什么时，价值 3T 的公司才会雇用你。为了比他们的团队更好地进行社区参与和社交倾听，您需要好好思考。为此，你需要写得好。希望在这里看到您的写作示例。请不要使用人工智能给我写电子邮件。这是显而易见的，它告诉我你将无法为财富 500 强公司写作。

两者的奖金高达 20 万美元 + 股权（是的，我们希望您与我们一起获胜）

请通过电子邮件 aadit@thenarrative.company 向我发送您最好的作品！

祝你好运。感谢 Twitter 家人❤️ 如果您推荐我们雇用的人，我很乐意支付 5,000 美元的推荐奖金。

author: @mark_k
summary_en: Google DeepMind is preparing to launch Gemini Bots, an AI agent system. This move signifies Google's strategic transition from generative-only models to task-executing AI agents, aiming to compete in the burgeoning autonomous agent market.
summary_zh: Google DeepMind正着手发布Gemini系列AI代理系统，旨在通过Agent化能力进入自动化智能交互市场。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Google DeepMind内部正加速研发并准备发布Gemini Bots智能代理系统。该举措标志着Google正式将其多模态大模型Gemini的能力从单纯的内容生成向具备任务执行能力的AI代理生态转型，以应对同行业在智能Agent领域的竞争布局。

elements_zh.what: 研发并准备发布Gemini Bots智能代理系统
elements_zh.why: 响应市场对高交互、任务自动化能力的需求

elements_en.what: Developing and preparing to release Gemini Bots agent system
elements_en.why: Strategic response to the market demand for task-oriented autonomous agents

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Google选择在Gemini架构上构建Bots，本质上是将多模态理解与决策执行深度锚定，试图通过生态惯性对抗轻量级Agent产品的灵活性竞争。其胜负手在于是否能在复杂API调用与系统权限交互中，平衡模型的实时推理延迟与Agent执行的安全护栏。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Building Bots atop the Gemini architecture indicates an effort to anchor multi-modal understanding with decision-making, aiming to leverage ecosystem inertia against nimble competitors. Success will depend on balancing real-time inference latency with robust security guardrails during complex API and system interactions.

title: Thariq Shihipar joins OpenAI after leaving Anthropic in October, saying he felt he could "personally contribute the most" to bringing AI to the world at OpenAI (@trq212)
title_en:
I've joined OpenAI!

I'm very proud of my time at Anthropic, and I'll continue to root for my former colleagues. Both companies have important roles to play in the future.

There is a tremendous amount of work ahead of us to bring AI to the world, and it will demand the very best of all of us. I felt that I could personally contribute the most to this effort at OpenAI.

I believe this is one of the great strengths of Silicon Valley, the flow of ideas and people.

I'm excited to join a team I've long admired, building incredible AI products for over a billion people, and to work alongside friends like @_catwu, @thsottiaux, @ajambrosino, @sharifshameem, @jxnlco and many others to push the frontier forward.

More than anything, I hope to make your experience of using AI just a little bit better.

I am once again at your service.

Thariq

为了将人工智能带入世界，我们还有大量的工作要做，这需要我们所有人都倾尽全力。我觉得我个人可以为 Ope

title: 如果您想在本地运行强大的 AI 并将 API 费用削减至 0 美元，请保存以下 10 个 GitHub 存储库： 1/ Ollama (181k) 选择一个开源模型，然后使用一个命令在终端中开始与它聊天。 2/ ComfyUI (132k) 构建图像 -
title_en:
If you want to run powerful AI locally and cut your API bills to $0, save these 10 GitHub repos:

1/ Ollama (181k)  
Pick an open-source model and start chatting with it in your terminal with one command.  
https://github.com/ollama/ollama

2/ ComfyUI (132k)  
Build an image-generation workflow by connecting each step on a visual canvas.  
https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI

3/ llama.cpp (128k)  
Run an LLM on your CPU, GPU, or a mix of both with this C/C++ inference engine.  
https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp

4/ GPT4All (77.4k)  
Chat with local models in a desktop app. A CPU is enough to get started.  
https://github.com/nomic-ai/gpt4all

5/ whisper.cpp (53.5k)  
Turn a recording into a transcript on your own machine using OpenAI’s Whisper.  
https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp

6/ LocalAI (49k)  
Got an app that calls the OpenAI API? Point it at a compatible API that serves models from your own machine.  
https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI

7/ text-generation-webui (47.6k)  
Load a local text model, adjust its settings and chat with it in your browser.  
https://github.com/oobabooga/text-generation-webui

8/ exo (47.3k)  
Split a model across several devices when it’s too big to fit on one.  
https://github.com/exo-explore/exo

9/ Jan (44.4k)  
Get a ChatGPT-style chat window on your desktop and use it with a local model.  
https://github.com/janhq/jan

10/ mlx-lm (6.9k)  
Run and fine-tune language models on an Apple Silicon Mac.  
https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm

You probably only need one to start. Ollama for a local chat, whisper.cpp for a transcript, or ComfyUI for an image.

title_en:
The 12 most common AI agent asks we're getting from mid-market and PE-backed companies right now (in no particular order):

1. Autonomous Operations Agents: Automating high-volume ops workflows like order exceptions, supplier follow-ups, client intake, and multi-system handoffs where ops teams currently spend all day moving data between tools.

2. Replacing Static RPA With Self-Healing Ops Agents: Swapping out brittle RPA bots and offshore babysitting with browser and API agents that keep running on legacy portals even when layouts change.

3. Ops Agents on Top of Legacy Systems: Building narrow vertical agents around a 20-year-old ERP, claims engine, or CRM without ripping out the system of record.

4. Finance Operations & Close Agents: Running accounts payable invoice matching, cash application, subledger reconciliations, and month-end close checks with full audit trails.

5. Billing, Collections & Revenue Leakage Agents: Comparing draft bills against contracted rates to catch missing charges, resolving billing disputes, and running voice agents for routine collections or patient balances.

6. Quote-to-Cash & Estimating Agents: Getting pricing rules out of a 30-year estimator's head so inbound RFQs and customer emails turn into accurate quotes and ERP orders the same day.

7. Client Onboarding, KYC & Document Ops Agents: Ingesting hundreds of messy client files, running cross-document completeness checks, flagging gaps, and prepping files for human sign-off.

8. Healthcare RCM & Prior Auth Agents: Running eligibility checks, prior authorizations, and denial analysis inside existing billing workflows so ops staff only step in on exceptions.

9. Productionizing Laptop Agent Prototypes: Taking working agents smart employees built in Claude or Replit and getting them hosted, tested, governed, and safe to put in front of customers.

10. Master Data Cleanup for Ops Agents:** Cleaning up disconnected spreadsheets and duplicate records across acquired PE companies so finance and ops agents stop treating bad data as facts.

11. Governed Private Cloud Agent Infrastructure: Setting up one model gateway inside their own AWS or Azure perimeter with user permissions, spend caps, audit logs, and zero regulated data leaving their cloud.

12. AI Coding Agents & Velocity Pods: Fixing the gap where engineers have Copilot or Cursor, pull request volume is up, and roadmap velocity is flat by adding proper harnesses, evals, and code review agents.

1. 自主运营代理：自动化大容量运营工作流程，例如订单例外、供应商跟进、客户接收和多系统交接，运营团队目前整天在工具之间移动数据。
full_text_zh:
目前，我们从中端市场和私募股权支持的公司那里得到了 12 种最常见的人工智能代理要求（排名不分先后）：

1. 自主运营代理：自动化大容量运营工作流程，例如订单例外、供应商跟进、客户接收和多系统交接，运营团队目前整天在工具之间移动数据。

2. 用自我修复操作代理取代静态 RPA：用浏览器和 API 代理取代脆弱的 RPA 机器人和离岸保姆，即使布局发生变化，这些代理仍能在旧门户上运行。

3. 遗留系统之上的运营代理：围绕已有 20 年历史的 ERP、索赔引擎或 CRM 构建狭窄的垂直代理，而无需删除记录系统。

4. 财务运营和结算代理：运行应付账款发票匹配、现金申请、分类账对账和月末结算检查，并提供完整的审计跟踪。

5. 计费、收款和收入泄漏代理：将草稿账单与合同费率进行比较，以发现遗漏的费用，解决计费争议，并运行语音代理进行日常收款或患者余额。

6. 报价到现金和估算代理：从拥有 30 年经验的估算师的头脑中获取定价规则，以便入站询价和客户电子邮件在同一天变成准确的报价和 ERP 订单。

7. 客户入职、KYC 和文档操作代理：接收数百个杂乱的客户文件、运行跨文档完整性检查、标记差距并准备文件以供人工签核。

8. 医疗保健 RCM 和事先授权代理：在现有计费工作流程中运行资格检查、事先授权和拒绝分析，以便运营人员仅在出现异常时介入。

9. 生产笔记本电脑代理原型：采用在 Claude 或 Replit 中构建的工作代理智能员工，并对其进行托管、测试、管理并安全地呈现在客户面前。

10. 运营代理的主数据清理：** 清理被收购的私募股权公司之间断开连接的电子表格和重复记录，以便财务和运营代理不再将不良数据视为事实。

11. 受管理的私有云代理基础设施：在自己的 AWS 或 Azure 边界内设置一个模型网关，具有用户权限、支出上限、审计日志和离开云的零监管数据。

12. AI 编码代理和 Velocity Pod：通过添加适当的工具、评估和代码审查代理，修复工程师拥有 Copilot 或 Cursor、拉取请求量增加以及路线图速度平稳的差距。
